The '''Gonmore system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Irishi sector/Legends|Irishi sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gonmore]].
